players.name: Markus Babbel
players.note: An ever-present in a treble-winning side, scoring in the UEFA Cup final, a year after a Champions League final with Bayern; a Germany first choice at his peak.

players.name: Sami Hyypiä
players.note: The defensive spine of the treble side and in the PFA Team of the Year; commanding in the air and a genuinely good passer.

players.name: Emile Heskey
players.note: Fourteen goals in the cup-treble season and an England starter at 22: the best football of his career, and the point where the power and pace were matched by end product.

players.name: Stéphane Henchoz
players.note: The blocking, front-foot half of the treble season’s centre-back pair; no distribution to speak of, but as good a pure defender as there was in the division that year.

players.name: Steven Gerrard
players.note: Twenty-nine starts and seven goals in the treble season; the physical power, passing range and shooting were all in place at twenty. A five-point rise on the breakthrough year, which is real development at that age.

players.name: Dietmar Hamann
players.note: The screening midfielder of the treble side; positionally outstanding and a far better passer than the role suggested.

players.name: Gary McAllister
players.note: Thirty-five and the controlling influence on the treble run-in; a fine passer whose game never depended on legs.

players.name: Michael Owen
players.note: Sixteen league goals and the two that won the FA Cup final; the hamstring trouble had been managed and the pace was back.

players.name: Robbie Fowler
players.note: Fifteen starts behind Owen and Heskey, but decisive in the cup treble; the finishing was still the best in the country when he played.

players.name: Christian Ziege
players.note: A treble-winning squad, but injury and Carragher restricted him to eleven starts; rated below his Middlesbrough season on form, not on standing.

players.name: Patrik Berger
players.note: Eleven starts; a knee injury cost him most of the season.

players.name: Jari Litmanen
players.note: One of the finest playmakers in Europe in the 1990s, at 29 and repeatedly injured; even in fragments the vision and finishing were of a different order to anything else in the Liverpool squad.
